title: trace steward decision
description: Routing decision emitted by the Scout-level Steward agent. Classifies an inbox entry into one of four states with machine-readable reason codes. The pre-merge gate (policy/steward.rego) operates on a fully-assembled bundle and is a separate evaluator; this artifact only records the routing classification.

reason_codes.description: Stable, machine-readable classification codes. Each code is either a bare slug (e.g. 'mapping-failure', 'eligible-high-confidence', 'no-actionable-input') or prefix:detail (e.g. 'upstream-ref-requires-human-review:major-version-jump'). Callers can group on the prefix for metrics.

evaluator.description: Identifier of the policy evaluator. Format: 'opa-rego/<query>' for the v0 Steward.

policy_sha256.description: sha256 of the rego file consulted; replay attribution.

inputs_summary.description: Compact echo of the policy inputs that drove this decision. Lets downstream metrics group by resolver verdict / trigger / confidence without re-reading the source files.
